entries.dc0e335f85a4193b: Under its “Medium-Term Management Plan 2027 (fiscal years 2025–2027),” with the theme “Change & Growth For All to 2027 ～Strengthening Sales and Construction Capabilities and Promoting Human Capital Management～,” the company is working on: thorough safety and compliance and quality improvement; further strengthening of sales and construction capabilities and expanding orders; creating profit through productivity improvement; strengthening recruitment and development of people and creating attractive workplaces; and business expansion through growth investment. The company has set a target of consolidated revenue of ¥260 billion for fiscal 2027. In addition, under the “CHUDENKO Group 2030 Vision,” the company has set targets for fiscal 2030 of consolidated revenue of ¥300 billion and a reduction of CO2 emissions of 46% or more (compared with fiscal 2013) toward carbon neutrality.
